title: Reserve Bank Amendment (Australian Reconstruction and Development Board) Bill 2019
short_title: Reserve Bank Amendment (Australian Reconstruction and Development Board) Bill 2019

summary.attribution: Written by a model from the explanatory memorandum; not the record
sentences: The bill would create a new body called the Australian Reconstruction and Development Board to help struggling farmers and related businesses.
The board would sit inside the Reserve Bank of Australia as a third board, using the bank's existing legal powers.
The explanatory memorandum says rural debt reached 135.4% of gross value of farm production in 2012.
changes: Establishes the Australian Reconstruction and Development Board.
Gives the board power to restructure debts and provide tailored finance for at-risk agriculture.
Requires the board to research and monitor industries to give early warning of problems.
summary.affected: Farmers, agricultural producers and associated industries and infrastructures.
